requirement: Projects can be created without choosing a monetization route or attaching provider credentials.
Offline output supports an evidence brief, article, 1080x1920 MP4, SRT, thumbnail and manifest.
Every project stores a versioned charter, audience, language, source rules and allowed providers.
Output variants retain original fact lineage and receive separate revisions and review.
High-risk profiles require specialized human review and cannot auto-publish.
Domain must not import SDK, DB, subprocess, UI, GPU or network modules.
All identifiers and revisions are stable, workspace-scoped and immutable after commit.
Asset object keys use SHA-256, verified bytes and same-filesystem atomic commit.
SQLite migrations, foreign keys and local filesystem checks precede mutations.
Structured artifact and approval digests use one pinned canonicalization with explicit version.
Workflow definitions are versioned DAGs with unique step IDs and declared I/O.
Step cache uses dependency hash, provider/config/model and policy snapshot; never caches side effects.
Job and step states follow explicit transition table; terminal attempts immutable.
Leases and fencing prevent expired workers committing state.
Cancellation halts new work and terminates owned subprocesses within configured bound.
Retry only bounded and classified idempotent operations; honor deadlines and backoff.
Durable intent and outbox record local commit before external effects.
Data retention, deletion journal and dependency lineage are enforced on restore.
Money uses integer minor units with currency/scale and explicit conversions.
Imported source carries provenance, retrieval time, digest, scope and retention status.
External collectors use permitted RSS/API/read-only scopes and bounded fetch.
Canonicalization and source dedup preserve distinct versions and sources.
Coverage distinguishes complete text, partial OCR, scan and unavailable pages.
Each factual claim maps to evidence refs, status and verification actor.
Computed statistics have explicit units, input refs, formula and uncertainty.
Topic ranking records weights, features, missing values and hard exclusions.
Brief separates sourced facts, inference, original analysis and opinion.
LLM structured generation is evidence-bound, validates output and has token/time limits.
Storyboard has typed scenes, deterministic timing and caption safe area.
Near-duplicate detection is advisory plus human review, not arbitrary automatic approval.
Renderer consumes validated scene bundle and produces real media plus execution manifest.
Asset registry records origin, rights scope, expiry, transformation and lineage.
Voice provider requires language, consent, rights and bounded duration/price.
ASR alignment preserves timing, text and review for uncertain spans.
GPU worker uses capability checks and configured concurrency with explicit fallback.
QC verifies dimensions, duration, codec, audio, captions, hashes and required metadata.
Remotion and other advanced renderers are optional adapters and isolated from credentials.
Own-media clipping preserves context, original rights and source timecodes.
CLI has stable JSON envelopes, exit statuses, no secret args and noninteractive behavior.
Dry-run and verify-only perform no business writes, network, reservations or external effects.
REST routes invoke same application use cases and enforce idempotency/revision.
WebUI binds loopback with authenticated session, CSRF/origin checks and accessible controls.
MCP exposes bounded draft/read use cases and cannot mint owner approval.
Every provider describes typed capabilities and versioned compatibility.
Provider contexts carry deadline, limits, data scope, correlation and redacted diagnostics.
Engram/PeerHub adapters are optional, versioned and tested against real contracts before enablement.
Export includes destination variant, rights/evidence, captions, metadata and artifact hashes.
Approval binds exact subject revision, action, intent hash, actor, expiry, policy and destination.
Account eligibility and posting permissions are distinct from content eligibility.
Remote publication states distinguish planned, authorized, sent, processing, published, failed and unknown.
Remote submit checks fresh rules, exact approval, privacy and persisted intent immediately before sending.
Remote ambiguity requires lookup/reconcile; no browser bypass or blind repost.
Manual export and attested upload receipt are distinct from API-verified publication.
Scheduling uses UTC and explicit reporting timezone, rechecks authorization at send.
Disconnect/revocation prevents further operations and triggers scoped retention duties.
Metric observations preserve platform definition, period, source, status, and null vs zero.
Revenue estimates distinguish estimates from settled actuals and eligibility unknown.
Ledger imports deduplicate event keys, support correction and reconciliation by currency.
Contribution margin includes measured costs and clearly labeled unallocated/unknown items.
Attribution tracks permitted aggregate CTA events and model/window without claiming causality.
Revenue-route eligibility is independently evaluated for ad, affiliate, sponsor, product, subscription and service.
Hosted billing and payment are separately approved, tenant scoped and idempotent.
Budget reserves worst-case known cap transactionally before paid operation.
Unknown external cost remains reserved pending reconciliation.
Default offline, zero spend and no public posting; fallback cannot escalate permission.
Secrets are host-scoped references, redacted and excluded from export/backup.
Untrusted source text, archives, media and paths are treated as data, not code.
Logs and audit preserve correlation, reason, actor and digest without confidential payloads.
Backup uses SQLite backup and verified CAS manifest with restore staging.
Capability, resource limits, timeouts, disk and retry failure are observable.
Policy snapshots record authority URL, date, scope, expiry, status and conservative default.
Collection rights, transformation rights and publication rights are independently checked.
Release gates require originality, evidence, rights, QC and explicit required disclosures.
Test-only taint propagates across derivative artifacts and cannot be overridden to public.
Correction and complaint affect claim lineage and queue user-authorized correction/retraction.
Third-party candidates require pinned version, exact license/SBOM/security and offline spike before adoption.
Reports distinguish PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN and record reproducible commands/evidence.
Portable Lite is a supported clean non-admin offline ZIP with private pinned runtimes.
Portable launcher derives root independently of cwd and stores logical/relative artifact identifiers.
Moved or incompatible disposable env is recreated using verified local wheelhouse and pinned lock.
Runtime caches and temp use process-scoped local roots; expected host writes are documented.
Pack manifest records platform, dependencies, license, exact size, hashes and signature; verify before execute.
Pack update and environment repair are atomic and preserve all business data.
Portable move and restore use consistent verified snapshot, ownership activation and no live DB copy.
Transferred credentials and authority do not automatically travel; uncertain side effects survive.
Strict offline mode permits loopback only; no implicit downloads, tracking or provider access.
GPU pack independently probes driver/VRAM/runtime and actual encoder; no automatic driver installation.
Studio pack launches local-only WebUI and pinned renderer without global Node/browser install.
Remote worker is opt-in authenticated, capability-scoped, hash-verified and does not access live DB.
Installed/server mode shares Core interfaces but requires separate explicit host/network authorization.
